RECORD VERDICT: repairable. 6 claims: 1 supported, 5 wrong_source — 2 of those are a straight swap of the record's own two sources (the wheat/panko evidence is on 2nenzaka but cited to Tabelog; the ten-seat counter is on Tabelog but cited to 2nenzaka), and 3 were UNCITED. Nothing unsupported. TRADING: yes — 洋食百名店 WEST 2025 選出店, 3.75 / 375 reviews with 2026/05 and 2026/04 visits, 定休日 水曜日. gf_confidence 'ask' is fine for a fry house that takes bookings, since the conversation can happen in advance. vegan_status 'ask' is OVER-RATED — see tier_recommendation.

why: 2nenzaka prints the shop's entire lunch and dinner menu and there is not one plant-based line on it: エビフライとカニクリームコロッケ, ビーフシチュー, ヒレ肉照焼, フライ定食, シチュー定食, 照焼定食, タンシチュー. Even the complimentary lunch ochazuke is served with 自家製のチリメン山椒 (dried baby sardines). The menu file records 0 vegan items, and the record's own vegan_detail says a vegan 'should not expect dedicated options'. Tonga, an equivalent Kyoto katsu/yoshoku house in this same shard, is correctly labelled 'no'. 'Vegan — ask in advance' sends someone to phone a ten-seat owner-run counter about a menu with nothing on it.

RECORD VERDICT: repairable. 5 claims: 0 supported as cited, 5 wrong_source — 4 were UNCITED and 1 (positives) cited a page carrying only half of it. Nothing unsupported: every claim turned out to be evidenceable, mostly on the shop's own site. TRADING: yes, and actively — the shop posted its 8月19日/20日/22日 menu on 2026-08-17, four days before this check. gf_confidence 'ask' and vegan_status 'ask' are both defensible and I am NOT recommending a change: the 2026 lunch is a rice plate rather than bread, the menu file records one genuinely vegan item (厚揚げのスイチリ, which the shop calls 無添加) and no vegan main, and the カレープレート's 半熟玉子 is removable on request — which is exactly what 'ask' means. Add 'cash only' (「お支払いは現金のみとさせていただいております」) to the record's flags.

quote: No information is published about the soba kitchen's wheat-handling practices. Traditional soba shops often mix in wheat flour (up to 20–30%) to help noodles bind; it is unknown whether this shop does so or processes wheat products on the same surfaces as its soba.
found: The Tabelog EN page is indeed silent (category 'Soba (Buckwheat noodles)', Menu: Set menu 0 / Food 0 / Drink 0). But the record's OWN other two sources answer the question the claim calls unknown. mog-mog: 「あたたかい蕎麦、うどんのメニューもありました。」 Retty's category line: 「そば（蕎麦） うどん」. And both name the house speciality as さらしなそば — Retty: 「手打ちのさらしな蕎麦や信州そばがいただけるお店」; nagano-saijiki: 「そばの実の外のカラを取り除き、内側のやわらかいところで打つ『さらしなそば』…我が店の一番人気です」.
note: LOUD: the claim's operative assertion is FALSE and it under-warns. It is not 'unknown whether this shop processes wheat products on the same surfaces' — udon (100% wheat) is on the menu, documented by two of the record's own three sources. And the shop's number-one seller is さらしなそば, milled from the refined inner core of the buckwheat, which essentially always needs a binder (wheat flour or egg white) because it will not bind on its own. Rewrite from 'unknown' to 'documented': udon in the same kitchen, plus sarashina soba's binder. Repair URL: https://retty.me/area/PRE20/ARE82/SUB8201/100000025491/ (udon in the category line) and https://www.nagano-saijiki.jp/shop/shop.php?n=7 (the shop's own description of sarashina). gf_confidence is already 'no', so no tier change — but gf_detail currently reads far weaker than the evidence warrants.

(2) MISTRANSLATION: 打ち立て means freshly CUT/kneaded and 茹でたて freshly BOILED; neither means freshly milled, which would be 挽きたて. RECORD VERDICT: defective. 5 claims: 2 supported, 2 wrong_source, 1 UNSUPPORTED. The unsupported one is the gf_cross_contamination claim, which calls the shop's wheat handling 'unknown' while two of the record's own three sources document udon on the menu and all of them name さらしなそば (a binder-dependent style) as the house speciality — the record under-warns on its own evidence. A second real error: 打ち立て・茹でたて was read as 'freshly milled' (that is 挽きたて) and attributed to a page that does not contain the phrase. TRADING: yes — Tabelog 20000487, 3.51-ish / 602 reviews with a July 2026 visit, hours 9:30-16:45, no reservations. gf_confidence 'no' and vegan_status 'no' are both CORRECT — no tier change recommended, the fix here is to the detail text, not the label. Stale-source flag: mog-mog is a 2015-05-22 snapshot.

quote: Solo elderly owner; no allergy handling, allergen menu, or dietary accommodation noted in any source. No English communication indicated. Contact at 026-234-2670 if needed.
found: nagano-gondo: 「おそばは、店主本人が手で打っております。別にこだわりもありませんが、一生懸命おいしいおそばをと頑張っています。」 and 「＊連絡先 026-234-2670」, 「本場戸隠から長野に下りて47年」. No allergen text on any source; Tabelog EN notes 「By-phone services may be limited to Japanese language only」.

It appears to be inferred from 「長野に下りて47年」, which dates the shop, not the person, and putting an age on a named small-business owner on inference is not something this app should print.

quote: Buckwheat soba itself is a naturally gluten-free grain; the noodles are hand-cut by the owner from Togakushi-sourced flour — no industrial additives noted.
found: nagano-gondo supports the hand-cutting: 「おそばは、店主本人が手で打っております。」 It does NOT say the flour is from Togakushi — it says the SHOP came from there: 「本場戸隠から長野に下りて47年」. The Togakushi flour is in the Tabelog review: 「お蕎麦は、戸隠のそば粉を使っています。」 Nothing on either page says anything about additives; the nearest line is 「別にこだわりもありませんが」.
note: LOUD — this is the most dangerous sentence on the record. (1) 'Buckwheat soba itself is a naturally gluten-free grain' sits in the positives of a shop whose FIRST listed genre is udon and whose tsuyu the same record confirms is soy-based. On a celiac app that framing reads as reassurance about a bowl that is not safe; it should be cut or explicitly reversed. (2) 'Togakushi-sourced flour' is not on the cited page — it is on the Tabelog review; nagano-gondo only says the shop relocated from Togakushi 47 years ago. (3) 'no industrial additives noted' is an absence dressed as a positive, and the page's own 「別にこだわりもありませんが」 cuts against it — delete it.

RECORD VERDICT: repairable. 5 claims: 2 supported, 3 wrong_source (1 of them uncited). Nothing unsupported. The serious issue is not a citation but a framing one: the positives field opens with 'Buckwheat soba itself is a naturally gluten-free grain' on a record whose own gf_detail says the tsuyu is wheat-soy and whose Tabelog genre is 「Udon (Wheat noodles), Soba (Buckwheat noodles)」 — udon listed FIRST. Cut it. TRADING: yes — Tabelog 20008703, 3.16 / 29 reviews with a January 2026 visit, hours 11:00-13:30 / 17:00-21:00, closed Sun and public holidays, counter seats only, no reservations. gf_confidence 'no' and vegan_status 'no' are both CORRECT; no tier change. Minor: nagano-gondo lists evening hours to 22:00 against Tabelog's 21:00 — prefer Tabelog.
